metadata.description: Laxmani is a small village in Madhya Pradesh's Alirajpur district known for its local restaurant serving Dal-Bafla and Paniya, a renowned delicacy. The restaurant has gained popularity, with notable figures like Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, judges, and top bureaucrats having dined there. Despite its modest setting, the restaurant has an inspiring backstory. The owner, Jhapu Kaka, began his journey by washing dishes in a Jain Temple and gradually learned the art of cooking. Even as the owner of this popular establishment, he continues to serve guests and personally prepares the food. His ultimate aspiration is to have Prime Minister Narendra Modi dine at his restaurant, showcasing his dedication to his craft and the local cuisine.
